changelog: Strengthened [Core Principles] with concise, surface-form guidance about the common mechanisms that cause premature boundaries (coordinated participant lists, locative/complementive nouns, ambiguous verbs lacking objects, exclusives like 'only' with contrast, pronouns inside verb phrases, and noun heads awaiting 'of'/'relative' postmodifiers). This gives the model clear, language-surface cues to lower confidence without changing candidate marking or adding categorical bans.

Replaced two example items (one in the 'Segment' set and one in the 'Do NOT Segment' set) to illustrate the specific risky patterns (coordinated participants and ambiguous verb/object situations). The new examples show how to mark candidates generously but rank risky splits lower or avoid them when they would break needed complements.
